idea: Evolve construction expressions with grammar-based genetic programming. The primitives are grid(p,q), cut(h|v, t, A, B), split(j), merge(j) and ring(j, A), applied to a rectangle. Expressions are evaluated exactly in Fractions to get (count, sum), and the fitness is the best sum at exactly n with zero-padding, so new compositional families are discovered automatically.
